task: On https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tiger, what does the Conservation section say about the estimated wild tiger population? Quote it and give the URL.

outcome.answer:
The Conservation section of the Tiger article has no prose sentence about the wild population estimate. It gives the figure in a table titled "Global wild tiger population", which lists country estimates for 2022. The table's total is **5,638–5,899**.

The table, quoted from the page:
- India: 3,167–3,682
- Russia: 573–600
- Indonesia: 393
- Nepal: 316–355
- Thailand: 148–189
- Malaysia: <150
- Bhutan: 131
- Bangladesh: 118–122
- China: >60
- Myanmar: 28
- **Total: 5,638–5,899**

The section also covers legal protection, national action plans and anti-poaching efforts. I did not find any other sentence in it that estimates the wild population.

URL: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tiger (section "Conservation", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tiger#Conservation)
